head: Bobara is a calm capybara app that logs the boba teas you buy
dek: Bobara ($4.99) shows Momo, a capybara soaking in a hot spring, and each boba tea you check in can bring him a new friend or treat. It was #89 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on November 13.
details: The hot spring follows your local weather and the real sunrise and sunset, and Home Screen widgets show what Momo is doing. There are no streaks or expiring content. It runs on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, with a watch complication; the listing also describes an Apple TV view, and the collection syncs across Apple devices. Lotus Apps, LLC released it on November 9.
where: App Store, iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch; $4.99
means: If you buy boba often and like cozy pet apps without daily streaks, this turns each drink into a small reward instead of a chore.
todo: Nothing to do unless you want it; the listing mentions a teahouse shop with packs but doesn't say if they cost extra.
thumb_words: A CAPYBARA THAT LOVES YOUR BOBA
